name: Scholomance: Krastinov's Ghoulish Potion lands on the damage dealer and splashes the tank
contract: Doctor Theolen Krastinov 11261 is a Scholomance (map 289, expansion 0) encounter boss. His Ascension kit throws
Krastinov's Ghoulish Potion 92624 (transform and charm, targets DEST_AREA_ENEMY with radius index 15 around the
target) at a random player (event 9004, first after 7.9-9.9 s, then every 25-27 s). The vanilla dungeon boss
control rule (BossControlTargeting.h) aims the potion only at a player whose CoA specialization neither tanks nor
heals, but its splash still reaches every player around that target, as on Ascension. Vanguard 21 tanks,
Grovekeeper 58 heals and Boltslinger 10 deals damage; all three stand together, so the tank is inside the splash.
The fight is at the Scholomance entrance hall used by the Barov scenario. The players are level 60 humans,
matching the boss. They group in Stormwind and teleport into one instance, where Krastinov is summoned at his own
stats; player health fixtures keep everyone alive through the window. The potion targets a destination, so its
cast carries no unit target; the scenario counts two throws and requires both to land on the damage dealer. The
tank and healer duo scenario shows the throw is never aimed at them.
